sentences.text: This petition was called on for hearing today.
Coram : Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ajay Rastogi
Hon'Ble Ms. Justice Bela M. Trivedi

For Petitioner(s) Mr. Anand Sanjay M Nuli, Adv.
 Mr. Suraj Kaushik, Adv.
 Mr. Dharm Singh, Adv.
 Ms. Nandini Pandey, Adv.
 Ms. Akhila Wali, Adv.
 Mr. Shiva Swaroop, Adv.
 For M/S. Nuli & Nuli, Aor
 For Respondent(s)

Upon hearing the counsel the Court made the following
 O R D E R
The learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the Notification in the instant case under
Section 4(1) of the Land Acquisition Act, published on 23.04.1998, is in reference to Village
Todalbagi,

Taluk Jamkhandi, and the Reference Court has awarded a compensation of Rs. 96,250/-
per acre. But in reference 16:41:03 IST Reason:
Ramu Since Deceased By His Lrs. vs The Special Land Acquisition Officer on 20 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/185556033/
1 to Notification under Section 4(1) published prior thereto i.e. on 22.01.1998 for the self-same village, the Reference Court at a later stage awarded a compensation of Rs.
1,90,000/- per acre, as it reflected from the order dated 04.07.2017.
The learned counsel for the petitioners has fairly conceded that this document was not placed before the High Court while the impugned order came to be passed.

After making submissions, the learned counsel seeks leave to withdraw the Special Leave Petition with liberty to file Review Application before the High Court apprising the facts which were available while the impugned order was passed by the High Court.
The Special Leave Petition is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty prayed for.

(JAYANT KUMAR ARORA) (VIRENDER SINGH)
